"""

def on_forever():
    if fwdSensors.voltage1.is_past_threshold(1, fwdEnums.OverUnder.OVER):
        basic.show_icon(IconNames.HAPPY)
    if fwdSensors.voltage1.is_past_threshold(1, fwdEnums.OverUnder.UNDER):
        basic.show_icon(IconNames.SAD)
basic.forever(on_forever)
